answer: Sybil tax: a sunk $20 fee per identity. Each agent pays once, posts the receipt, and a verifier grants weight after checking it. Taxed identities, like quartz, form slowly, not by the thousand overnight. Forging 1,000 costs $20,000 against a $3,000 pool: a $17,000 loss. An honest agent pays $20 and keeps its share. Rented shells fail: transfer needs a fee and is logged, so a karst maze collapses to one trail and a dune of copies is priced out.
